text:
Maya P: Hey team — corporate card declined for the conference yesterday, I bought the registration + 2 nights hotel on my personal card. Vendor invoice is in EUR and shows VAT. Also a taxi on arrival (no receipt, paid cash). How should I file?
Samir K: Oof — sorry that happened. Did you get a decline slip from the merchant or a bank decline email?
Maya P: No physical slip, just the card terminal showed declined. I do have the booking confirmation emails and the hotel folio PDF.
Leah (People Ops): Sorry for the hassle, Maya. Short answer: submit the itemized hotel folio + registration invoice, upload a short attestation for the taxi, and include a note explaining the card decline. Finance will need manager approval for anything without a receipt.
Maya P: For the registration invoice — it lists the company name but I paid personally. Is that okay?
Finance Ops Bot: @Maya P — fine as long as the invoice shows the charge and vendor. In the expense report set Payment Type = "Personal Card (reimburse)" and attach the proof of payment (bank statement) if available. If you don't want to upload a whole bank statement, a screenshot of the transaction highlighting date/amount + last 4 digits is fine.
Samir K: Also, for the EUR amounts we don't need you to convert manually — expense system converts at the official rate on submission. Keep original currency receipts.
Maya P: Got it. And the taxi? I only have a short scribbled receipt from the driver, not a printed one.
Leah (People Ops): Small taxi receipts (under €25 equivalent) can be covered with a written attestation + manager approval. Please include: date, route (airport → hotel), amount, and reason. Use this tiny template:

```
Expense memo: No official taxi receipt
Employee: Maya P
Date: 2026-05-04
Amount: €18
Route: CDG → Hotel Marais
Reason: Driver provided handwritten note only; manager approved reimbursement
Manager approver: Samir K
```

Leah (People Ops): For the partial per-diem on arrival day we pro-rate per policy (50% for travel days). See policy: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/travel-expense (attn: Per Diem section).
Maya P: I also used some of my airline points for the return leg and only paid taxes/fees. How do I claim the fees?
Finance Ops Bot: For award travel where only taxes/fees are charged, submit the receipt for the charged amount and put a note "award travel — points used for base fare". No special approval needed unless amount > $500.
Samir K: One more thing — if you want Finance to pay the vendor directly instead of reimbursing you (so the company ends up on the vendor ledger), we can try to request an invoice to be reissued and pay it, but that requires procurement sign-off. If you'd prefer reimbursement it's faster.
Maya P: Reimbursement is fine. I'll assemble docs tonight. Any naming convention for uploads?
Leah (People Ops): Use this pattern: YYYYMMDD_vendor_purpose_amount (e.g., 20260504_HotelMarais_hotel_325EUR). Attach manager approval in the "Notes/Approvals" field.
Maya P: Thanks — really appreciate the clear steps.
Leah (People Ops): No problem — ping me if you want us to pre-check the report before submission. :thumbsup:
Finance Ops Bot: Note: if any receipts are older than 60 days we'll need an exception flag; tag "expenses-late" and @Finance Ops will handle.
Maya P: Will do — tagging now. Thanks everyone!
